_how_to_edit: Change status/phase/build_order/notes here; the map updates on reload. status: Modeled | In progress | Next | Planned. phase: 0 = done, 1 = Brandywine chain (top-down), 2-4 = independent watersheds by priority. build_order: overall sequence. drains_to / inflow_from: how models feed each other. dashboard: link shown when a model is live.

M03.model: Upper East Branch Brandywine & Marsh Creek
M03.notes: Top of the East Branch: Honey Brook, Marsh Creek Lake and dam. Model built (60 sq mi, 279k cells); next: terrain and mesh in HEC-RAS, test run, then NEER.

M01.notes: HEC-RAS 2D with storm sewers; 9 design storms run; live EOC dashboard.

M02.notes: Downingtown. Takes inflow from Upper East Branch (M03) and Valley Creek (M01). NOAA forecast gauge DWNP1, borough storm sewers, Ida 2021 high-water marks.
M02.drains_to: M05 Brandywine main stem - Chadds Ford
M02.inflow_from: M03 Upper East Branch Brandywine & Marsh Creek, M01 Valley Creek (Exton)

M12.notes: Rural tributaries of the West Branch; built before Coatesville because they drain into it.

M04.notes: Coatesville. Takes inflow from Buck Run & Doe Run (M12).
M04.drains_to: M05 Brandywine main stem - Chadds Ford

M05.notes: Brandywine below the East and West Branch confluence; takes inflow from Downingtown (M02) and Coatesville (M04).
M05.inflow_from: M02 East Branch Brandywine - Downingtown, M04 West Branch Brandywine - Coatesville

M06.notes: Phoenixville borough at the Schuylkill confluence; Schuylkill backwater as boundary.

M07.notes: The other Valley Creek (Paoli to Valley Forge) plus Chester County side of the Schuylkill below Phoenixville.

M09.towns: Avondale, West Grove, London Grove, Landenberg
M09.notes: Wild and Scenic river; boroughs of Avondale and West Grove.

M10.notes: Kennett Square borough; drains to Delaware.

M11.model: Eastern creeks - Chester, Ridley, Crum, Darby
M11.notes: Headwaters only (creeks flow into Delaware County); West Chester borough sewers.

M15.towns: North Coventry, East Coventry, South Coventry
M15.notes: Pigeon Creek, Sprogles Run, Sixpenny Creek; Pottstown area across the river.

M14.notes: Big Elk, Little Elk and North East Creeks; drain to Chesapeake.

M16.notes: Small slivers at the Lancaster line.
